title: Two-Stage Extrinsic Calibration of a Static Line-Scanning Lidar with a Rotary Platform
description:
arXiv:2607.18578v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A line-scanning lidar yields range and azimuth values in a fixed plane. To perceive surrounding objects in 3D, there must be relative motion between the lidar plane and the object. Thus, using a rotating base-platform is promising for industrial applications where objects need to be scanned or inspected precisely, and is the main focus of this work.
